titles.romaji: Ginga Tetsudou 999: Jikuu wo Koeta Energy no Tabi
titles.english: Galaxy Express 999: Jikuu wo Koeta Energy no Tabi
titles.native: 銀河鉄道999～時空を超えたエネルギーの旅～

description:
Animated shorts made to promote the Japanese electricity company Kyuushuu Electric Power (Kyuuden).

Tetsurou and Maetel visit five interplanetary stops (including Earth) and see how each locale deals with energy.
